description: One Tron block by height or block id, read from our own node: producer, timestamp, transaction count split by contract type, and the tx ids in it. When to use: inspect a specific block, or confirm which block a transaction landed in. Do not use: for the tip only (tron_get_current_block) or for a transaction itself (tron_get_transaction). Boundary: our Tron node is a lite full node that keeps only a recent window (~6 days). An empty result means 'outside our window', NOT 'the block does not exist'. Returns: found, number, block_id, parent_hash, timestamp_ms, tx_count, tx_by_type, producer_address, tx_ids, retention_window.

block_id.description: Block id (64 hex chars); takes precedence over height

name: tron_get_block
